# Label Taxonomy

The canonical label policy lives in the
[NemoClaw Community maintainer-policy skill](../.agents/skills/nemoclaw-community-maintainer-policies/references/label-taxonomy.md).
Its adjacent JSON file is the machine-readable source for validation and live
label audits.

Do not maintain a second label table here. Use native GitHub Issue Type for
issue classification and labels only for routing, workflow queues, contribution
signals, and pull request type.
